final: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_alp, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10
